title: Optimizing Your Chiropractic Google Ads: Keywords, Ad Copy, and Landing Pages | ChiroCandy

facts.fact: The page was published on June 24, 2024 and updated on September 18, 2026.
According to the page, Google notes that some low-volume queries are omitted from the search terms report for privacy, so the report is not a complete list of every search.
facts.quote: Google notes that some low-volume queries are omitted from the report for privacy, so it is not a complete list of every search.

facts.fact: The page defines a keyword as part of the advertiser's targeting setup and a search term as what a person entered.
facts.quote: A keyword is part of your targeting setup; a search term is what someone entered.

facts.fact: The page states that a click on a phone number, a connected call, a submitted form, and an attended appointment represent different stages of conversion.
facts.quote: A click on a phone number, a connected call, a submitted form, and an attended appointment represent different stages.

facts.fact: According to the page, Google's conversion tools measure only the actions configured for the account, so the usefulness of the report depends on what the advertiser chooses to measure.
facts.quote: Google’s conversion tools measure actions configured for the account; the usefulness of the report depends on what you choose to measure.
